title: FACS-based protocol to assess cytotoxicity and clonogenic potential of colorectal cancer stem cells using a Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway reporter
protocol: Collect cells at single-cell level by trypsinization (or by exposing them to Accutase).
Count viable cells by using Trypan blue and plate 500,000 cells in a well of a 6 well plate with 2 ml of cell culture medium supplemented with 8 μg/ml of Polybrene.
Assess the sensitivity of cells to polybrene in terms of concentration and exposure time before proceeding with lentiviral transduction.
Add lentiviral particles, diluted or concentrated (MOI of 10-100), to the cells and mix gently.
Incubate the cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 24 h.
Replace culture medium with fresh cell culture medium after 24 hours of lentiviral transduction.
Evaluate lentiviral transduction by observing constitutive RFP expression under a fluorescent microscope after 72 hours.
Evaluate the transduction efficiency by FACS after expanding the transduced cells.
Enrich the cells for the RFP+ cell population if necessary.
Pause point: Proceed with the following steps or store sorted RFP+ cells in liquid nitrogen for long-term storage (>1 year).
Perform Brilliant Violet 421 Annexin V staining to discriminate alive cells within TOP-GFP cells.
Harvest RFP+-sorted TOP-GFP transduced cells by trypsinization.
Mechanically open the cell clumps by pipetting up and down with harsh pressure if cells grow in sphere or island.
Collect the supernatant and pool it together with the cell suspension after trypsinization for Brilliant Violet 421 Annexin V staining.
Spin cells at high speed (no more than 500 g) to pellet them properly.
Count living cells using Trypan Blue exclusion and seed 50,000 cells per well in a 24-well plate.
Culture cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 overnight before treatment.
Dilute drugs and prepare solvent control according to experiment design.
Add diluted drugs or solvent control dropwise to the wells.
Culture cells for different times according to time point settings.
Collect and pellet the treated cells.
Collect the supernatant in a 15 mL polypropylene centrifuge tube.
Label the tubes properly.
Trypsinize and collect the cells in the corresponding tubes.
Dissociate the clumps by pipetting up and down with harsh pressure if cells grow in sphere or island to obtain a single-cell suspension.
Spin at 750 g for 4 min and pellet the cells.
Label untreated cells as Annexin V staining negative controls.
Label high concentration drug treated cells as Annexin V staining positive controls.
Label the cells with Brilliant Violet 421 Annexin V.
Wash cells twice with Staining Buffer (cat. #420201).
Resuspend cells in Annexin V Binding Buffer (cat. #422201) at a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL (minimum volume 100 μL).
Transfer 100 μL of cell suspension into a Falcon 5 mL Round Bottom High Clarity PP tube.
Add 5 μL of Brilliant Violet 421 Annexin V to the cell suspension.
Gently vortex the cells.
Incubate the cells for 15 min at room temperature, in the dark.
Add 400 μL of Annexin V Binding Buffer to each tube.
Filter the cells through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Measure the fluorescence of Brilliant Violet 421 Annexin V by Flow Cytometry.
Start up BD FACSMelody cell sorter.
Run daily fluidics startup.
Optional: Perform the flow cell clean.
Install the sort nozzle.
Prepare a tube of B&D CS&T RUO beads by mixing 500 μL of PBS with 2 drops of beads.
Vortex the mix of beads for at least 20 s before loading the tube and performing the Optical configuration.
Prepare a tube of Accudrop beads by mixing 500 μL of PBS with 1 drop of beads.
Vortex the mix of beads for at least 20 s before loading the tube and performing the drop delay.
Set forward scatter (FSC) channel for measurement.
Set side scatter (SSC) channel for measurement.
Set FITC channel for measurement.
Set PE channel for measurement.
Set Brilliant Violet421 channel for measurement.
Create an appropriate gating strategy based on the protocol.
Run and record the experiment as described in Figure 5.
Export FCS files for data plotting and analysis.
Perform data analysis using FlowJo software.
Conduct cell sorting followed by extreme limiting dilution analysis (ELDA).
Harvest cells.
Trypsinize and collect the cells in the corresponding tubes.
Disassociate the clumps by pipetting up and down with harsh pressure if cells grow in spheres or islands.
Label the cells with Brilliant Violet 421 Annexin V.
Filter the cells through a 70 μm cell strainer to avoid the formation of cell clumps.
Maintain cell culture conditions the same for all replicates.
Heat inactivate FBS by heating it for 30 minutes at 56°C with mixing.
Store samples at room temperature in a mix of 1:1 cell culture medium: PBS, 2% FBS, and 1 mM EDTA.
Start up BD FACSMelody cell sorter.
Load a previously saved experiment layout or create a new one.
Load the tube of cells that need to be analyzed/sorted.
Create an appropriate gating strategy to analyze/sort viable cells (SCC-A versus FSC-A: cells; FSC-H versus FSC-A: single cells; BV421 versus FSC-A: alive cells).
Select the format, volume and sort mode in the “Set up” sort tab.
Prepare 96 well plates.
Add 200 μL of complete culture medium in each well.
Change the recipient stand to a 96 well plate holder.
Plan the layout of the 96 well plate according to the experiment design.
Start the sorting and record the events.
Monitor the stability of the cell cloud during sorting.
Adjust for any variations in laser intensity or fluidics that may affect cell isolation.
Be aware of temperature changes in the room where the instrument is located.
Return 96 well plates to the incubator after sorting.
Culture the plates at 37°C for 2 weeks, extending as needed based on proliferation rate.
Count wells in which tumor spheres grow out.
Exclude wells with no growth when determining clonogenic potential.
